author: Roboboss25
body:
USERNAME: Roboboss25

REASON FOR BAN: Accused No knock back hacking

WHY I SHOULD BE UNNBANNED:

Hello, I was banned from the server on June 3 for "Hacking" after waiting a few day I've decided to write this. I've been a player on this network for quite some time now, and I have never broken any rules or gotten banned/kicked. But while just enjoying my time playing on Nexus sky wars I get Perma Banned for accused "hacking by having no knock back". I don't know what this admin or mod thought he saw (maybe lag) but, I have never hacked nor do I know how to hack. This network is one of the only servers I play on and I would never risk getting banned by hacking. I read the ban appeal post, but I have no screen shots to prove my side (But on the contrary I didn't know I was going to get banned) Anyway I hope this goes through, and we get this whole mess sorted out.

Thank you,

Roboboss25

title: Roboboss25 - Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately I have decided to deny your appeal due to the fact that you are currently using another account to access the server. This is called "Ban Evading".

Both accounts will be banned and will not be appealed.

Regards,
Dylan.
